newsitem.title: UK: Cricket-Paul Reiffel included in Australia's 2nd Test side.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-Paul Reiffel included in Australia's 2nd Test side.

text.p: Pace bowler Paul Reiffel has been selected in the Australian team to meet England in the second test starting at Lord's on Thursday.
Reiffel, 32, picked up nine wickets in the tourists' matches against Nottinghamshire and Leicestershire after joining the team as a replacement for the injured Andy Bichel.
He takes over from Jason Gillespie, who broke down in the first test which England won by nine wickets.
The Australians practised at Lord's on Tuesday and coach Geoff Marsh and captain Mark Taylor decided to tell Reiffel he would be playing on Thursday.
